sets.title: Wishes and Regrets Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct form for wishes and regrets
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильную форму для желаний и сожалений

items.prompt: Я _____ заказать кофе, пожалуйста. (I would like to order coffee, please.)
items.promptEnglish: I would like to order coffee, please.
items.explanation: Polite wish: хотел бы (I would like to). More polite than хочу (I want).

items.prompt: _____, что ты не пришёл на вечеринку. (It's a pity you didn't come to the party.)
items.promptEnglish: It's a pity you didn't come to the party.
items.hint: Expressing regret/disappointment about something that didn't happen.
items.explanation: Жаль, что... = It's a pity that... Used for expressing regret.

items.prompt: _____ позвонить ей раньше. (We should have called her earlier.)
items.promptEnglish: We should have called her earlier.
items.hint: Past regret: something should have been done but wasn't.
items.explanation: Надо было + infinitive = should have (past regret). We didn't call, but should have.

items.prompt: Мне _____ побывать в Японии. (I would like to visit Japan. - soft wish)
items.promptEnglish: I would like to visit Japan (softer form).
items.hint: The softest, most gentle way to express a wish (impersonal).
items.explanation: Мне хотелось бы = I would like to (impersonal, very polite/gentle).

items.prompt: Я _____ поговорить с вами. (I would like to speak with you. - polite)
items.promptEnglish: I would like to speak with you.
items.explanation: Polite wish: хотела бы (female form of хотел бы). Gender shows in past tense form.

items.prompt: _____, что мы не успели на поезд. (It's a pity we missed the train.)
items.promptEnglish: It's a pity we missed the train.
items.hint: Expressing disappointment about a missed opportunity.
items.explanation: Жаль, что... = It's a pity that... Regret about something that happened.

items.prompt: _____ взять зонт. Теперь мы мокрые. (We should have taken an umbrella. Now we're wet.)
items.promptEnglish: We should have taken an umbrella.
items.hint: Past regret about something not done. Which form?
items.explanation: Надо было + infinitive for past regret: we should have taken an umbrella but didn't.

minimalPairs.explanation: Direct statement of desire: хочу (I want). Less polite, more casual.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ кофе, пожалуйста. (I would like coffee, please. - polite)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I would like coffee, please (polite request).
minimalPairs.explanation: Polite request: хотел бы (I would like). Softer and more formal than хочу.

minimalPairs.context: _____ позвонить маме. (I need to call mom. - present obligation)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I need to call mom (right now).
minimalPairs.explanation: Present obligation: надо (need to). Not a regret, but a current need.

minimalPairs.context: _____ позвонить маме вчера. (I should have called mom yesterday. - regret)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I should have called mom yesterday.
minimalPairs.explanation: Past regret: надо было (should have). I didn't call, but I should have.

sets.title: Sort and Fill
sets.description: Sort expressions by type and fill in the correct forms

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Is this a Wish, a Regret, or 'Should Have'?

items.word: Я хотел бы узнать ваше мнение.
Мне хотелось бы побывать в Италии.

blanks: Я _____ задать вам вопрос. (I would like to ask you a question.)
_____, что магазин уже закрыт. (It's a pity the store is already closed.)
_____ купить продукты вчера. (We should have bought groceries yesterday.)
Мне _____ посетить этот музей. (I would like to visit this museum. - soft)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Three main constructions: wish, regret, should have
hints: Disappointment about a closed store. Which word starts this?
Past regret about not buying groceries. Which construction?
explanations: Soft impersonal wish: хотелось бы + infinitive.

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix errors in wish and regret constructions
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте ошибки в конструкциях желания и сожаления

errorCorrection.hint: Without бы this is past tense ('I wanted'), not a polite wish.
errorCorrection.explanation: Хотел = 'I wanted' (past). Хотел бы = 'I would like' (polite wish). The бы makes it conditional.

errorCorrection.hint: Вчера = past. 'Need to call yesterday' doesn't work. You need 'should have.'
errorCorrection.explanation: Past regret requires надо было: Надо было позвонить вчера = Should have called yesterday.

errorCorrection.hint: Жаль expresses regret. Is 'she will come tomorrow' something to regret? Usually we regret negative things.
errorCorrection.explanation: Жаль, что она придёт is unusual (regretting she'll come). More natural: Жаль, что она не придёт (It's a pity she won't come).

errorCorrection.sentence: Мне хочется бы поехать в отпуск.
errorCorrection.hint: With бы, the verb must be past tense: хотелось бы, not хочется бы.
errorCorrection.explanation: The conditional requires past tense + бы: хотелось бы (not present хочется бы).

translation.english: I would like to book a room, please.
translation.answer: Я хотел бы забронировать номер, пожалуйста.
acceptableVariants: Я хотела бы забронировать номер, пожалуйста.
translation.hint: Polite wish: хотел бы + забронировать (to book), номер (room)

translation.english: It's a pity we didn't see the movie.
translation.answer: Жаль, что мы не посмотрели фильм.
acceptableVariants: Жаль, что мы не видели этот фильм.
translation.hint: Regret: Жаль, что + не посмотрели (didn't watch)
Past regret: Надо было + выехать (to leave/depart)

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All wish and regret patterns in one round
sets.descriptionRussian: Все паттерны желаний и сожалений в одном раунде

items.prompt: _____, что ты не сказал мне раньше. (It's a pity you didn't tell me earlier.)
items.promptEnglish: It's a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
items.hint: Expressing regret/disappointment about something not done.
items.explanation: Regret about something that didn't happen: Жаль, что не сказал.

items.prompt: _____ предупредить её заранее. (I should have warned her in advance.)
items.promptEnglish: I should have warned her in advance.
items.hint: Past regret (didn't warn, but should have).
items.explanation: Past regret: Надо было предупредить. The warning should have happened but didn't.

items.prompt: Я _____ попросить вас о помощи. (I would like to ask you for help.)
items.promptEnglish: I would like to ask you for help.
items.explanation: Polite wish: хотел бы попросить. More appropriate than direct хочу.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ поговорить. (I would like to talk. - polite wish)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I would like to talk (polite wish).
minimalPairs.explanation: Polite wish: хотел бы (conditional). Without бы, хотел means 'I wanted' (past tense).

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ поговорить, но не успел. (I wanted to talk but didn't have time. - past fact)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I wanted to talk but didn't have time.
minimalPairs.explanation: Past fact (actually wanted): хотел (past tense). Not a hypothetical wish.

minimalPairs.context: _____ сделать это вчера. (I should have done this yesterday. - regret)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I should have done this yesterday (regret).
minimalPairs.explanation: Past regret: надо было (should have). The action was missed.

minimalPairs.context: _____ сделать это сегодня. (I need to do this today. - present obligation)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I need to do this today (present).
minimalPairs.explanation: Present obligation: надо (need to). Still time to do it.
